description: Lifecycle: the previous run's marker (including numeric, null and missing ids), the state after the ops, the marker and level file as written, and every line with the boot line left out. Covers the session summary, noteStat kinds and values, errorsByScope order, timed and kept levels, and .env.local.

cases.name: a first run writes an unclean marker and no warning
a marker left unclean names the previous session as crashed

cases.name: a previous run that ended cleanly is not reported
an unreadable marker counts as no previous run
endSession writes the summary and a clean marker
endSession unclean says dirty
the summary lists the five slowest channels, highest first
peak memory keeps the largest value
a keep level file restores the level and scopes at boot
a level file without keep is removed at boot
a level file that is not valid JSON is left alone
keep without a level keeps the environment level
DRAGGY_DEBUG from the environment raises every listed scope
in development .env.local stands in for DRAGGY_DEBUG
the environment wins over .env.local in development
an empty DRAGGY_DEBUG falls through to .env.local in development
a packaged build ignores .env.local
a CRLF .env.local value has no carriage return
the first matching .env.local line wins
spaces around the equals sign in .env.local are not read
a scope ending in s loses its last letter in .env.local (TS quirk)
a timed level reverts to INFO when its time is up
a timed level is capped at 24 hours
a new setLevel cancels the pending revert
keep writes level.json while verbose logging is on
keep without verbose logging writes no level.json
dropping keep removes level.json
a timed keep level reverts and removes level.json
error scopes with integer-like names print first in the summary
a null noteStat value adds nothing and a missing one adds one
a noteStat kind the writer does not know is ignored
a previous marker with a numeric id keeps the number
